sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 2–3), with the soprano's line in the alto, the alto's line in the bass, transposed. Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence rising by a third every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted (3 times), in a sequence rising by a third every half bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted.
sections.leads: From F major to G minor

sections.label: Subject in E♭ major, rhythm varied (Bass)
Link
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 5–9) in part, with the soprano's line in the tenor, the tenor's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: From E♭ major to C minor

sections.label: Together: Subject in C minor, rhythm varied (Soprano); Answer in C minor, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times). Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted (3 times), in a sequence rising by a step every two bars. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted (4 times).
sections.leads: From C minor to F major

sections.label: Stretto: Answer in F major, rhythm varied (Soprano); Subject in B♭ major (Alto)
Link
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From B♭ major to F major

sections.label: Answer in F major, rhythm varied (Tenor)
Stretto: Subject in D minor, rhythm varied (Tenor); Subject in D minor, rhythm varied (Soprano)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From D minor to B♭ major; perfect cadence in D minor at bar 44

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in B♭ major (Bass); Subject in B♭ major (Soprano)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 5–9) in part, in the same voices, a fourth higher. Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From B♭ major to E♭ major

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: Between two statements in E♭ major

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in E♭ major (Bass); Subject in E♭ major (Alto)
Episode 6
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 5–9) in part, with the alto's line in the bass, the tenor's line in the soprano, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes. Returns in Episode 9 (bars 68–77).
sections.leads: From E♭ major to B♭ major

sections.label: Episode 7
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 2–3), with the alto's line in the bass, at the same pitch level. Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted.
sections.leads: From B♭ major to D minor

sections.label: Episode 8
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From D minor to B♭ major

sections.label: Subject in B♭ major (Bass); Subject in B♭ major, ornamented (Soprano)
Episode 9
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 6 (bars 55–56), with the soprano's line in the tenor, a fifth higher. Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a fourth every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject (2 times). Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted (3 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every bar.
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in B♭ major at bar 78

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: the opening of the subject. Returns in the codetta (bars 5–9). Returns in Episode 1 (bars 16–24). Returns in Episode 7 (bars 58–60).

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 2–3) in part, with the soprano's line in the tenor, a fourth lower. Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted and the opening of the subject. Bass: the opening of the subject. Returns in Link (bars 27–28). Returns in Episode 4 (bars 48–49). Returns in Episode 6 (bars 55–56).

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times). Bass: free counterpoint.
